notes.title: Slowly but surely!
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been a few months since the last update - five months to be exact, because that's how old my daughter is.

As it turns out, newly-baked parents definitely have little time - and even when they do find the time, they don't have the strength to work on the game. The time I could devote to creating "For Your Information" I spend most of on my regular work as a Front-End Developer in one of the Polish Software Houses.

I would like to announce with great pleasure that work is underway on the next level - I can't promise any date, but you can be sure that it will appear someday and it will be much longer than all three previous ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084214/68ed6046c6dbf559507a6993d982efa51c8dcecc.png[/img]

As you can see from the picture, our main character, despite the lack of certification - will be able to operate a forklift! (Seriously, it drives and lifts things!)

Darek, Developer.

notes.title: Player tips and some improvements
notes.notes:
Hi! In today's update we are adding "Player Hints". In the upper left corner, a hint will be displayed on what goal you should focus on.

Another big change in this update is the reduction in the number of servers that can be found on Level 3 (with the boss). Instead of three, there will be one server to repair, but this one server will appear in a different place each time.

And the last big change is the implementation of a new version of Guards on Level 2.

Additional changes:
-The manager detects the player faster
-The door keycard and server in the player's hands will ignore the manager's thrown monitors
-Increased light range on Level 3
-Guards can open locked doors with a card on Level 2

Let me know how you like these changes :)

notes.title: We are fixing level 2 and a new achievement
notes.notes:
Hello, an exceptionally small update today because we had a small error regarding the height of one of the motion sensors on the second map. Now you will be able to get there by crouching.

Work on level 4 is still ongoing, we will keep you updated!

Full list of changes:
- Adjusted the height of the sensor so you can walk under it on level 2.
- Added the "Fruity Thursdays" achievement.
- Added text background to main menu and pause menu.
- Added the ability to restart a level in the pause menu.
- Added Depth of Field

notes.title: Level selection and couple improvements!
notes.notes:
A list of changes:

- Level selection introduced. By clicking "Start Game", if you have discovered levels other than the first one, you will see a view of the leves on which you have already played the game. Naturally, due to the fact that this system did not exist before, your previous progress is not taken into account.

- In the options you will find the option to set the mouse sensitivity.

- The elevator from Level 3 has been fixed, this time the servers really need to be fixed.

- The main character gained a shadow and a body in mirrors and reflections!

To the next one!

notes.title: Optimization and several improvements
notes.notes:
Hi! Today's update does not bring any major changes to the gameplay, although it is crucial in terms of optimization. We received from you many comments about the performance of the third level (with THE manager), it was leaving much to be desired.

We spent last few days struggling to achieve better performance on this level and finally, after many attempts, we found a reason that was so simple - yet not so obvious.

Let us know if the update helped you pass smoothly and unnoticed. 

List of additional changes:
- Return to the Main Menu will reset checkpoint information
- Characters that look at the player will only do so in the X axis (no more levitating characters)
- Fallen shelf physics are disabled when knocked over
- Document shelf interior collision has been disabled
- Security at Level 1 got an motivational speech and doesn't give up so easily
(blocking the door with an object will not cause the security to freeze)
- Removed "Ultra" graphics option
- Added fog on city streets on Level 2
- Cameras in Level 2 will detect the player much faster
(you won't be able to just run across the room with them)
- Added "You broke it" and "Higher Education" achievements
- Added background music to Level 3
- Employees closing lockers does not increase the player's open locker stat on Steam

notes.title: Update of work on "For Your Information"
notes.notes:
The first month of intensive playtests is behind us! We would like to thank you and the other 484 playtest participants and the wonderful 63 people who bought the game!
This is the best form of support in the game production process and thanks to you we can see so many cool items on the maps that we can use to hit heads of other employees.
We do not use Asset Stores when it comes to visual models or effects and all 3D models are either ours or ordered from freelancers.

List of fixes and improvements that you can see in the latest update:

General
- The newly hired security guard knows how to use doors
- Steam achievements earned will be displayed during the game, not after the game
- Objects that can be picked up make sounds when thrown
- Employees actually work at their desks (various office sounds implemented)
- Adjusted the resolution of light maps for better optimization.
- Added variable FOV while running.
- Added the ability to jump while crouching - which will make "high jumping" easier (crouching while jumping makes us able to jump on higher objects)
- New graphics menu with more complex options to change.

Level 1:
- Respawning at the checkpoint in Level 1 does not make it difficult to complete the board (Enter does not work).
- The achievement of stamping documents and putting them back counts points correctly.
- The songs depend on the checkpoint at which you respawn.

Level 3:
- The manager does not get stuck on furniture
- The manager has been optimized, but we will continue to work on optimizing the part of the office where he appears
- Added the missing model needed to obtain the "Jelly Stapler" achievement

Once again, many thanks for such great feedback and to the people who bought the game!

notes.title: For Your Information - Single Player Version!
notes.notes:
A few months after the release of [b]For Your Information[/b] in the Multiplayer version, we quickly realized that it was a small mistake and we started our game from the wrong side. That's why we're happy to announce that a Single Player version is now in production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084214/9e4a906db6f5ffefa8e217e2566b5bee9feefa77.png[/img]

Thanks to the opinions, comments and your tests, as well as the statistics we collected, we quickly realized that the multiplayer version in the unknown world of For Your Information does not answer your questions about the world presented, the lore and what the conflict of spies and bodyguards really means.

Therefore, the main goal of the single player version is to tell you the story of the company you work for and we will outline the conflict of two groups known from the multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084214/3631583b5f132704904996e4b5ddb2202b8d1904.png[/img]

The new version also means the transfer of work to Unreal Engine 5. We see great progress and acceleration of our work on this engine and we are sure that we can provide you with a much better gameplay.

We will soon start a Playtest of the basic mechanics that will be present in the game - don't expect a plot or complicated sequences - just a simple open space and a simple task - getting out of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084214/7eca6970301daffa82bd033c16d870408f1eb333.png[/img]

So - we'll see you soon at the playtests - don't forget to leave feedback on our Discord!

Ah and Happy Birthday in 2024!
